import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf

/-!
# Section transport for module sheaves

A module morphism into a pushforward transports sections to any open contained
in the inverse image. This is the module analogue of `Scheme.Hom.appLE`.
It supplies the section maps of a linearized sheaf on stable opens.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped AlgebraicGeometry

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
  {M : Y.Modules} {N : X.Modules}

/-- Transport sections along a module map into a pushforward and then restrict. -/
noncomputable def Hom.appLE (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) : Γ(M, U) ⟶ Γ(N, V) :=
  φ.app U ≫ N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem Hom.appLE_map (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    {U : Y.Opens} {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (i : op V ⟶ op W) :
    φ.appLE U V h ≫ N.presheaf.map i =
      φ.appLE U W (i.unop.le.trans h) := by
  rw [Hom.appLE, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

/-- Section transport commutes with ordinary restriction along an inclusion of
opens.  This specialization exposes the form used by affine-overlap gluing. -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem Hom.appLE_map_homOfLE (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    {U : Y.Opens} {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) :
    φ.appLE U V h ≫ N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op =
      φ.appLE U W (hWV.trans h) := by
  exact φ.appLE_map h (homOfLE hWV).op

/- Restriction transport is compatible with two successive inclusions. -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem Hom.appLE_map_homOfLE_comp (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    {U : Y.Opens} {V W Z : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (hZW : Z ≤ W) :
    φ.appLE U V h ≫ N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op ≫
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hZW).op =
      φ.appLE U Z (hZW.trans (hWV.trans h)) := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, φ.appLE_map_homOfLE h hWV,
    φ.appLE_map_homOfLE (hWV.trans h) hZW]

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem Hom.map_appLE (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    {U U' : Y.Opens} {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (i : op U' ⟶ op U) :
    M.presheaf.map i ≫ φ.appLE U V h =
      φ.appLE U' V (h.trans ((Opens.map f.base).map i.unop).le) := by
  unfold Hom.appLE
  have hn := φ.mapPresheaf.naturality i
  change M.presheaf.map i ≫ φ.app U =
    φ.app U' ≫ N.presheaf.map ((Opens.map f.base).map i.unop).op at hn
  rw [← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem Hom.appLE_eq_app (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N) (U : Y.Opens) :
    φ.appLE U (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl = φ.app U := by
  change φ.app U ≫ N.presheaf.map (𝟙 (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))) = φ.app U
  erw [N.presheaf.map_id]
  exact Category.comp_id _

/-- Section transport is semilinear for the actual map on section rings. -/
theorem Hom.appLE_smul (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    {U : Y.Opens} {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (r : Γ(Y, U)) (s : Γ(M, U)) :
    φ.appLE U V h (r • s) = f.appLE U V h r • φ.appLE U V h s := by
  change N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (φ.app U (r • s)) = _
  rw [Hom.app_smul]
  exact N.map_smul (homOfLE h) (f.app U r) (φ.app U s)

/-- Composing module maps into pushforwards composes their section transports. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem Hom.appLE_comp_appLE {g : Y ⟶ Z} {P : Z.Modules}
    (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N) (ψ : P ⟶ (pushforward g).obj M)
    (U : Z.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (W : X.Opens)
    (h₁ : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h₂ : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    ψ.appLE U V h₁ ≫ φ.appLE V W h₂ =
      (ψ ≫ (pushforward g).map φ ≫ (pushforwardComp f g).hom.app N).appLE U W
        (h₂.trans ((Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE h₁)).le) := by
  simp only [Hom.appLE, Hom.comp_app, pushforward_map_app,
    pushforwardComp_hom_app_app]
  have hn := φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h₁).op
  change M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op ≫ φ.app V =
    φ.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≫ N.presheaf.map ((Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE h₁)).op at hn
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (M.presheaf.map _) (φ.app V), hn,
    Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

/-- Transport is unchanged when the underlying scheme morphism is rewritten. -/
theorem Hom.appLE_pushforwardCongr {f' : X ⟶ Y} (e : f = f')
    (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward f).obj N)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    (φ ≫ (pushforwardCongr e).hom.app N).appLE U V (e ▸ h) =
      φ.appLE U V h := by
  subst e
  simp only [Hom.appLE, Hom.comp_app, pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app,
    eqToHom_refl, op_id]
  erw [N.presheaf.map_id]
  rfl

/-- The identity linearization acts as the identity on every open. -/
@[simp]
theorem appLE_pushforwardId_inv (F : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) :
    ((pushforwardId X).inv.app F).appLE U U le_rfl = 𝟙 Γ(F, U) := by
  simp only [Hom.appLE, pushforwardId_inv_app_app, Category.id_comp]
  exact F.presheaf.map_id _

/-- The identity pushforward transport is the ordinary restriction map on
sections of every smaller open. -/
@[simp]
theorem Hom.appLE_pushforwardId_inv_of_le (F : X.Modules)
    {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    ((pushforwardId X).inv.app F).appLE U V h =
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op := by
  simp only [Hom.appLE, pushforwardId_inv_app_app, Category.id_comp]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
